sub_limits_waiting_notes: Both Indemnity (Hospitalization) and Benefit (Personal Accident) product. Base Cover Option 1 (Hospitalization) and Option 2 (PA) selectable.

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: Admission in Hospital beyond 24 hours - up to Sum Insured
inpatient_hospitalization.notes: Includes In-Patient, Day Care, AYUSH, Domiciliary, Pre/Post Hospitalization, Modern Treatments, Organ Donor, Bariatric, Home Health Care.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All Day Care procedures (less than 24 hours)

domiciliary_treatment.limit_text: Up to Schedule limit, 3 continuous days minimum

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Inpatient AYUSH up to Schedule limit (Ayurveda, Yoga, Naturopathy, Unani, Siddha, Homeopathy)

organ_donor_expenses.limit_text: Up to Sum Insured for organ donation

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road Ambulance + Air Ambulance + Radio Cab (per Schedule)
ambulance_cover.notes: Air Ambulance within India only; Radio Cab to nearest Hospital/home.

critical_illness_cover.notes: PA rider in Base Cover Option 2 available.

restoration_benefit.limit_text: Restore Benefit: Restoration of Base Sum Insured unlimited times during Policy Year
restoration_benefit.notes: After Claim payment; for subsequent claims only.

permanent_exclusions: Adventure Sports (covered only with safety conditions)
notable_exclusions_summary: Health Alpha is a flexible policy with optional Personal Accident (Option 2) and core Hospitalization Cover (Option 1). 14 covered adventure sports with prescribed safety conditions. Provides unlimited Restore Benefit, Modern Treatments, Home Health Care, and AYUSH. Excludes maternity, infertility, refractive error, and treatment outside India.
claim_process_summary: Cashless and reimbursement claims via TPA. 18001021111. Air Ambulance and Modern Treatments subject to specific medical criteria.
available_riders: Personal Accident (Base Cover Option 2 - AD, PTD, PPD, TTD, Home Modification, Child Education, Loan Protector)
Road Ambulance / Air Ambulance / Radio Cab
